subject.title: fix(cli): reject unknown models in config set

question: Should `openclaw config set` fail before persistence when a changed text-model reference or a provider-dependent bare fallback cannot resolve through the active catalog?
rationale: The implementation is a narrow reuse of runtime resolution and has focused proof, but choosing fail-closed behavior changes the upgrade and operator contract for an established public CLI flow.

options.title: Approve fail-closed model validation
options.body: Treat unresolved changed primaries and affected fallback references as set-time errors so invalid active configuration cannot be persisted.

options.title: Retain deferred validation
options.body: Keep permissive writes until maintainers define a different migration or opt-in policy for validating existing configuration workflows.

recommendation.title: Approve fail-closed model validation
recommendation.body: Treat unresolved changed primaries and affected fallback references as set-time errors so invalid active configuration cannot be persisted.
